standard.summary: population 策略专用：某个参数的梯度范数超过“全体平均值 x 这个倍数”就算离群层，压学习率。
standard.effect: 默认 2.0。必须 >= 1.0，否则启动报错。heuristic 策略完全不用这个字段。
standard.whenToUse: 怀疑个别层梯度异常拖累整体时配合 population 用。
standard.avoidWhen: 调太小会让大多数层都被当成离群。

standard_en.summary: population-only: a parameter whose gradient norm exceeds this factor times the per-param mean counts as an outlier layer and cools the lr.
standard_en.effect: Default 2.0. Must be >= 1.0 or startup fails. The heuristic strategy never reads it.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use with population when a few layers look pathological.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too small a value flags most layers as outliers.
